headline: Iran threatens US warships in the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Tehran threatened US warships in the Strait of Hormuz. US President Trump said he had, for now, called off what he described as the biggest US military attack since World War II.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so threats there are closely watched by energy markets.
why_moved: Threats to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz raise the risk of disrupted Gulf oil flows, which tends to lift crude prices.
